transcript.content: Good [morning/afternoon], I'm Dr. [Your Name]. Can you tell me what's been troubling you lately that brought you in today?

Afternoon. 

...Well, I suppose it's because of an incident the other day. I, uh... I blew up at one of the younger volunteers. Over a crooked tablecloth, of all things. 

I don't usually talk to people that way. Never have. So... I guess that's what brought me in.
Can you tell me more about how you’ve been feeling lately, especially before and after that incident with the volunteer?

I don't really know. Just... normal, I suppose. Maybe a bit tired. 

And after it happened, well... I just felt bad about raising my voice. I don't really dwell on these things much. That's about all there is to it.
Have you noticed yourself getting irritated or angry more easily than usual, even about small things?

Well... like I just said, there was that business with the tablecloth. I suppose you could call that a small thing. 

But other than that... no, I don't think so. Like I told you, I don't usually talk to people that way. I'm not an angry person. It was just that one time.
Have you lost interest in things you usually enjoy, or found that you don’t get as much pleasure from your usual activities lately?
No, not really. I still do the same things I always do. Read the paper... watch a bit of television. It's all just the same.
Have you been feeling down, sad, or hopeless more often lately, even if just a little?
No, I wouldn't say that. I'm just... getting on with things, same as always. There's no point sitting around feeling sorry for yourself, is there? I'm fine.
Have you noticed any changes in your appetite or weight lately?
No... my appetite is fine. I just eat my regular meals, same as always. I haven't noticed any difference in my weight, either.
Have you had any trouble sleeping lately, like trouble falling asleep, staying asleep, or waking up too early?

Well... maybe a bit, I suppose. Since the robbery, anyway. I get into bed tired enough, but... I just end up lying there. Listening for noises. And then I'm awake before dawn. It just feels like I hardly slept at all.
Can you tell me more about the robbery you mentioned? Did it happen recently, and how did it affect you?
It was... about a week ago. Just outside the bank. I'd really rather not go into all the details of it, to be honest. It's just... that's when this started. About a week.
Since the robbery, have you found yourself thinking about it more than you want to, or having memories of it come back in a way that feels upsetting or intrusive?

I suppose. I don't really want to think about it, but... it happens. I'll just be sitting at my kitchen table, and... out of nowhere, I hear that man's rough voice in my head. Or I see the... the donation envelope hitting the ground. It just comes back.
Since the robbery, have you found yourself avoiding certain places, people, or activities because they remind you of what happened?

Well... yes, I suppose. I've been taking the long way around when I go out. Just so I don't have to pass the bank. And... I haven't gone into the festival storage room, either. It just... it brings the whole thing a bit too close, I guess. Best to just stay away from it.
Since the robbery, have you been more jumpy or on edge, like you’re always watching for danger?

I suppose I have been a bit... jumpy. The other day, I was near the senior center and a car backfired. I... well, I jumped so hard my chest actually hurt. And my hands wouldn't stop shaking for a few minutes. So, yes... a bit on edge, I guess.
Since the robbery, have you had any trouble with your daily routine, work, or relationships because of how you've been feeling?

Well... yes. I suppose things have slipped a bit. I haven't been keeping up with the Día de los Muertos planning like I usually do. Just... haven't had the energy for it. And I haven't been to the card nights either. I just... I don't really feel steady enough to be sitting around a table with people right now.
Have your symptoms, like trouble sleeping, being on edge, or having memories come back, lasted for more than a month now?
No, not a month. It's only been... well, about a week. Just since it happened outside the bank.
Have these symptoms, like trouble sleeping, being on edge, or having memories come back, been happening for more than a month now?
I... I think I just said that. It's only been a week. Since the bank. Not a month.
Have these symptoms, like trouble sleeping, being on edge, or having memories come back, been happening for more than a month now?
I... yes, I just mentioned that. It's only been a week. Since the bank. Not a month.
Have these symptoms, like trouble sleeping, being on edge, or having memories come back, been happening for more than a month now?
I don't... I don't understand why you keep asking me that. Like I said, it's just been a week. Since the bank. Not a month.
Have these symptoms, like trouble sleeping, being on edge, or having memories come back, been happening for more than a month now?
I... I don't know why we keep going over this. No, not a month. Just... a week. Since it happened outside the bank.
